_comment: Soft configuration for figure computations: random seeds, statistical-model seeds, multiple-comparison families, and gold/manuscript reference values used by the per-figure checks. Nothing statistical should be hardcoded in the figure scripts; read it from here.

figure_4.note: One row per animal -> parameter boundary; Wald SE is optimizer/start dependent. Seeds below reproduce the gold Statistical_report.xlsx SEs while preserving significance. Transition metrics require native file order (NOT Time_bin-sorted).

dynamics_score.definition: log(d_ctrl / d_els) in 2D MDS space; ELS positive = control-like distance larger

figure_5.frequency_model: GEE NB (Fig 3A recipe) with 3 groups, dual-reference (Control-ref + ELS-ref)

cv.WARNING: frame-level split leaks temporal autocorrelation; animal-level split is the leakage-free option

figure_7.feature_note: Only 5 bundled pose features available; full keypoint/pairwise-distance set is NOT in the repo
